title: The Mandalorian
description: The Mandalorian let Luke Skywalker take Grogu into his custody for training and resumed bounty hunting. He joined a covert with The Armorer and Paz Vizsla, but was sent away after revealing he had removed his helmet. He joined Boba Fett for the fight against the Pyke Syndicate, and was reunited with Grogu mid-fight.
